Plaits y stmlib: Mutable Instruments / Emilie Gillet — https://github.com/pichenettes/eurorack (licencia MIT)
URing modifications: dx_units.h Pow2Fast shift cast to unsigned (UB fix).
URing modifications: stmlib/utils/dsp.h always_inline via STMLIB_ALWAYS_INLINE macro (MSVC portability).
URing modifications: plaits/resources.cc empty lookup_table_i32_table gets one nullptr entry (MSVC portability).
URing modifications: clouds/dsp/grain.h clamps the window table index below 1.0 (read past the end of lut_window).
URing modifications: clouds/dsp/correlator.cc skips the 32-bit shift when offset_bits is 0 (undefined behaviour).
URing modifications: clouds/dsp/looping_sample_player.h computes the fractional read position with unsigned shifts (signed overflow).
URing modifications: stmlib/fft/shy_fft.h negative indices use signed offsets; clouds/dsp/pvoc/frame_transformation.cc wraps the phase increment through int32 (undefined float-to-uint16 conversion).
